firstPlayerRule: The rulebook only says to determine a starting player; it gives no method, so choose one however your group likes.
clarifications: Players take turns in clockwise order.
At the start of the game each player rolls a single die on their turn.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the rulebook linked from the Pandasaurus Games Machi Koro product page (https://pandasaurusgames.com/products/machi-koro); SHA-256 db8e242809a8c5a99facdc2940fde4a7487479f1c307314ec56f8b04302ac358, 8 pages. PDF page 4, Game Setup ends 'Determine a starting player and begin play.' with no method given; Game Flow says turns go clockwise. The rulebook has four Landmarks and credits IDW Games, copyright 2014 Grounding Inc., matching Machi Koro BGG 143884. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: This is the original English rulebook with four Landmarks. The 5th Anniversary Edition rulebook was not checked and may word setup differently.
